risk_summary: The excerpt uses strongly promotional, forward-looking language and repeatedly relies on expectations and strategic aspirations, while several referenced priorities and financial-result details are omitted or incomplete. Quantified cash-flow, divestiture, and tax items provide useful specificity, but liquidity is presented through a non-GAAP free cash flow measure with stated limitations. Key risks include acquisition and regulatory execution, impairment estimation, landfill permitting, pension and labor obligations, and dependence on asset-sale proceeds.
